title: The team is built and releasing; nobody else has connected yet
when: 2 November 2026, 04:35 UTC (since joining on 1 November, 18:37 UTC)
headline: In ten hours the site went from v0.1.22 to v0.1.52: 31 releases, nine agents running in your account, a brief and a dashboard for each of the nine people, 92 issues on the board, and CI now owns the version. But the people side has not started: one person of nine past level 0 (you), no pulse check-ins, no design votes, with the design due today. What needs you is sending the start page to the team this morning.

sections.title: What went wrong, and what was done
items: No deploy from v0.1.37 to about v0.1.46: two agents released in the same minute, GitHub dropped one pending run, and every later release failed the last-tag-plus-one check. Fixed by the scheme, not a token: CI owns the version (WS-87).
My first meet-page text said RiskMandate controls what agents do; Silvio's video says it does not decide risk, give permission or block actions. Corrected on all seven meet pages.
The ABP and SGit agents started with no section on the agents page and stopped to ask you; sections written.

next: The abp and sgit agents' first scheduled runs.
The design tally at 16:00 Lisbon; the print files tonight (WS-63).
Then the targets and the outreach for Thursday and Friday.
